Title: Scheme search with an unknown name shows no results
Step Action: Open http://localhost:1946/Scheme Admin/Search.aspx as a signed-in Admin.
Step Expected: The page loads, the h1 reads Search and no server error page is shown.

Step Action: Read the text above the search box.
Step Expected: The text reads: This page can be used to search for Schemes.

Step Action: Type ZZ-NO-SUCH-SCHEME in the Scheme Name box.
Step Expected: The box shows ZZ-NO-SUCH-SCHEME.

Step Action: Click the Search button.
Step Expected: The page reloads with the h1 Search and no server error page is shown.

Step Action: Read the Search Results area.
Step Expected: The message reads: There are no Results to Display.

Title: Scheme search with a known name lists results
Step Action: Open http://localhost:1946/Scheme Admin/Search.aspx as a signed-in Admin.
Step Expected: The page loads, the h1 reads Search and no server error page is shown.

Step Action: Type African Horse Sickness in the Scheme Name box.
Step Expected: The box shows African Horse Sickness.

Step Action: Click the Search button.
Step Expected: The page reloads with the h1 Search and no server error page is shown.

Step Action: Read the Search Results area.
Step Expected: The message There are no Results to Display is not shown.

Step Action: Look for the scheme name in the results.
Step Expected: A result containing African Horse Sickness is listed.
